title: Builder authoring for lists must be trivial
summary: A designer should declare an authoritative collection, stable row identity, visible fields and optional selection/filter/sort/actions. The Builder and renderer own the repetitive mechanics; application authors should not write DOM loops or invent per-app row identity rules.

minimum_authoring_shape.workspaceContextSlot: opaque authoritative workspace context when applicable

invariants: Builder-generated definitions should encode the row contract declaratively.
Renderer code should not guess identity from generic keys such as id, key, code or ref.
Filter and sort affordances emit semantic intent; they do not locally redefine authoritative membership.
Invalid required collection state must not leave an enabled Continue/Submit/row-action control.
The same authored pattern should work for passenger lists, bank worklists, claims, cases, positions, orders and staff rows.

provenance.claim: Builder row authoring shape and authority rules.
